abort.cannot_connect_hub: Could not reach airdress.co to sign in. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant and try again.
abort.denied: The link was declined on your operator. Start again to try once more.
abort.enroll_refused: Your operator refused to link Home Assistant. Start again, or check the operator's machine settings.
abort.expired: The link was not approved in time. Start again to get a new code.
abort.link_denied: The sign-in was declined at airdress.co. Start again to try once more.
abort.link_expired: The sign-in code expired before it was used. Start again to get a new code.

error.busy: Your operator has too many links waiting to be approved. Try again in a minute.
error.enroll_refused: Your operator refused to link Home Assistant.
error.invalid_address: Enter the address of your airdress, for example `name.a.airdr.es`.
error.invalid_preauth_key: The pre-auth key was not accepted. Ask for a new one on your operator.
error.not_enabled: This airdress does not accept Home Assistant links. Machine enrollment is turned off on its operator.
error.operator_proof: The operator's answer could not be verified, so it was not trusted. Check the address and try again.

progress.approve:
Open [your operator's approval page]({url}) and approve **{user_code}**.

Before approving, check that the operator shows this confirmation code:

```
{confirmation_code}
```

This page continues by itself once you approve.
progress.link:
Open [airdress.co]({url}), sign in, and confirm the code:

```
{code}
```

This page continues by itself once you have chosen your airdress.

data_description.address: The address of your airdress, for example `name.a.airdr.es`.

address.description: Home Assistant asks your airdress's operator to link it. You approve the link there.
address.title: Link by address

data_description.preauth_key: A key you created on your operator to link a machine without approving it by hand.

user.description: Link Home Assistant to your airdress, so that your functions can run the actions and read the entities you choose to share. Nothing is shared until you choose it in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: Your operator at {operator} no longer accepts this Home Assistant. If its approval lapsed, Home Assistant asks for it again and stays linked as it was. If it was revoked, Home Assistant enrolls as a new machine, which you approve and link again. What you share is kept.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to your airdress's operator.

home_disabled.message: The home this Home Assistant is linked as is switched off on your operator.

no_pinned_key.message: This link has no pinned operator key. Remove it and link again.

not_authorized.message: Your operator no longer accepts this Home Assistant. It was revoked or its approval lapsed; reauthenticate to link it again.

not_linked.message: Your operator knows this Home Assistant but has not linked it as a home yet.

notify_not_connected.message: Your airdress's operator is not connected, so the message was not sent.

notify_rate_limited.message: Your airdress took no more messages from Home Assistant for now. It accepts a few a minute and a couple of hundred a day.

notify_disabled.message: Messaging from Home Assistant is turned off in Airdress.

notify_too_long.message: The message is too long for Airdress: at most 1,000 characters, the title included.

notify_failed.message: Your airdress's operator could not store the message.

data_description.observe: Your functions can read their state.
data_description.operate: Your functions can run their actions, and read their state.

init.description: Choose what your airdress's functions can reach. Nothing else is visible to them.

data.sensitive: Allow Airdress to operate these sensitive entities

data_description.sensitive: Locks, alarm panels, and garage doors, doors, gates, windows or unclassified covers. An entity not chosen here is refused, whatever your operator allows.

sensitive.description: {count} of the entities you chose to operate lock, unlock or open something. They are refused unless you allow each one here and on your operator.
sensitive.title: Sensitive entities

location.title: Your location in Home Assistant
location.description: Your airdress's functions can show where you are on {trackers}. Home Assistant always keeps a history of whether you are home, away or in one of its zones. To keep even that out, exclude the tracker in Home Assistant's recorder settings.

data.record_location: Keep a history of your coordinates

data_description.record_location: Off: Home Assistant's history holds only home, away or the zone, never where exactly you were.

location_confirm.title: Keep your coordinates?
location_confirm.description: Home Assistant will keep your coordinates for its history period (10 days unless you changed it). They will be in every backup, and anything in Home Assistant that reads history can see them. Coordinates recorded before you turn this off again stay until the history period ends.
